# Identity attributes keep types apart; non-identity attributes merge.
builder
prim i1 integer mm=1:10 desc=first
prim i2 integer mm=1:10 desc=second
prim i3 integer mm=0:
prim i4 integer mm=:5 desc=another-very-long-description
str s1 unrestricted pat=^a+$ def=s:aaa
str s2 unrestricted pat=^a+$ def=s:aaa
str s3 unrestricted ml=2:4 def=n:1.5
prim b bool def=b:true
prim nul null def=null
cls c a:i1,b:i2,c:i3,d:i4,e:s1,f:s2,g:s3,h:b,i:nul n=C
cls d a:i3,b:i4 n=D
top C c
top D d
finish printonrewrite
print
unify 2,3 debug
print
